blocks.text: P-pop powerhouse SB19 is set to make its way to Indio, California, in April 2027 after being announced as part of the lineup for the annual music and arts festival. The quintet — composed of Pablo, Josh, Stell, Ken and Justin — will perform on April 10 and 17, as per the list of the performers shared by the music festival through its social media pages on Wednesday, Nov. 11. “THE NEXT STOP IS OFFICIALLY ON THE CALENDAR. COACHELLA 2027. See you on the other side of the desert, A’TIN!” the group said on its Instagram page. View this post on […]... Keep on reading: SB19 joins 2027 Coachella lineup
